messages:
Alexa: Anyone up for a lunchtime bouldering meetup today? 12:30 @garage wall — quick 30min circuits, low-key.
Tom: Down if I can make it by 12:45. Can someone bring a pad?
Ravi: I can bring a crash pad :boulder: and a couple quick routes.
Sara: I have a call at 12:30, can do a 1pm run instead (3mi campus loop).
Alexa: Hmm we could split — boulder at 12:30, run at 1. Vote with reactions?
Linda: Boulder :thumbsup:
Jon: Run :thumbsup: (but low effort pls)
Maria: I can do both. Happy to shuttle crash pad from garage to green if needed.
Tom: Awesome, Maria — you're a saint. Also, bring chalk if you can.
Alexa: OK poll then: react with :boulder: for boulder, :runner: for run. Meeting point for climbing: loading dock by bikes. For run: north quad fountain.
Ravi: Heads up — campus gates lock at 1pm today. If anyone needs to leave late, plan accordingly.
Sara: Thanks — I’ll join the run at 1 and cheer from a distance for the boulder crew.
Jon: Quick ask: anyone up for 5x30s hangboard after the climb? I promise it won’t kill you :)
Tom: Ha maybe next time. I’m in for just laps today.
Alexa: Cool. Final: 12:30 boulder (Alexa, Ravi, Tom, Maria, Linda), 1pm run (Sara, Jon, Maria). Slack reactions are the tiebreaker. See y’all at the loading dock! :muscle:
